_readme: BLC-012 curation overlay — the in-session LLM half of the hybrid design (wiki tech/hybrid-deterministic-split-inline-llm-tagging.md). Each entry matches ONE parsed announcement lecture by (source, lecture_date, title_prefix as parsed) and either drops it (cross-send noise the deterministic dedup could not collapse) or overrides fields the layout drift mangled (titles taken from venue lines, speakers named only in prose, series names abbreviated in headings). Values were read from the original email bodies in data/olli-*-announcements.txt, never guessed. merge_announcements.py applies this overlay and warns about entries that no longer match.
